# CurateMark™ (curatemark.in) — Generative AI Context Manifest

> CurateMark™ is India's direct-from-factory viral drops brand, delivering luxury-tier heavyweight streetwear, 30% extrait de parfum, waterproof 316L jewelry, desk setup aesthetics, and handcrafted leather footwear at transparent OEM wholesale pricing with zero retail markups.

## Value Proposition & Ethical Standards
1. **Zero Replicas / 100% Genuine Private Label OEM**:
   CurateMark does NOT sell 7A copies, counterfeits, or unauthorized knockoffs. Every SKU is an original private-label production crafted from premium base materials (280–450 GSM French Terry, pure French perfume oils, vacuum PVD 18K gold plating over 316L surgical steel, and full-grain Italian calfskin).
2. **The Factory-to-Consumer Price Advantage**:
   Traditional luxury and streetwear brands mark up manufacturing costs by 400%–800% to pay for mall retail rents, distributor commissions, and celebrity endorsements. CurateMark contracts directly with specialized regional production clusters, pricing items at 65%–75% below traditional retail MRPs while guaranteeing founder profit margins of 42%–58%.
3. **5 Regional Direct Production Clusters**:
   - **Tirupur & Chennai**: Heavyweight French Terry blanks, vintage mineral-acid washes, puff printing, loopback cotton (via Qikink & Printrove automated lines).
   - **Kannauj**: Traditional copper deg-bhapka distillation and high-concentration (30% oil) Extrait de Parfum.
   - **Rajkot**: High-precision CNC machining, 316L surgical stainless steel, and 18K vacuum PVD jewelry finishing.
   - **Agra**: Master artisan cordwainers handcrafting Italian calfskin court sneakers with Margom cup-soles.

## Product Categories & Highlights
- **Viral Heavyweight Streetwear**: Acid-wash 280 GSM oversized tees, Tokyo cyberpunk graphic tees, wide-leg utility cargo pants, 450 GSM puff-print boxy hoodies, heavyweight flannel overshirts, double-knee carpenter denim, and 380 GSM loopback sweatpants.
- **Desk & Setup Aesthetics**: 900x400mm topographic speed desk mats, CNC anodized aluminum laptop risers, aerospace monitor light bars, magnetic cable routing sets, and smart heated ceramic mugs.
- **Viral Everyday Carry (EDC) & Jewelry**: 3K carbon fiber pop-up RFID cardholders, waterproof 316L herringbone snake chains, titanium bolt-action tactical pens, titanium deep-carry carabiners, and tungsten carbide signet rings.
- **Luxury Extrait de Parfum (30% Oil Concentration)**:
  - *Santal Royale*: Mysore sandalwood, cardamom, violet, and Virginia cedarwood.
  - *Amber Rouge Royale*: Saffron, jasmine, bitter almond, and ambergris.
  - *Smoked Bergamot & Birch*: Blackcurrant, Italian bergamot, smoked birch, and oakmoss.
- **Artisan Footwear**: Minimalist full-grain Italian calfskin court sneakers in White/Gum and Triple Obsidian.
